title: Slovakian Beef Casserole with Nuts
description: A hearty, kid-friendly dish featuring tender beef fillet, a crunchy nut topping, and a rich, savory sauce.
instructions: Cut the beef fillet into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth and heavy cream, whisking continuously.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, toss the chopped walnuts with the melted butter.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the beef cubes.
Pour half of the sauce over the beef, then top with half of the walnut mixture.
Repeat the layers, starting with the beef, then the sauce, and finally the walnut mixture.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the casserole is golden brown and the beef is cooked to your liking.
